fusions.name: Kindled Charge
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles to the target and strike it for 14 fire damage, setting it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaving it 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Struck Flint
fusions.desc: You strike a spark off your shoe at the first enemy in line for 4 fire damage, setting it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Trail of Cinders
fusions.desc: Leaves a line of cinders 6 tiles long behind you for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sparks Off the Shoes
fusions.desc: Every few tiles you run, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
